architectureSummary: Premium Analytics Workspace implemented in Next.js App Router.
Executive-grade analytics are grouped into Analytics, Intelligence and Executive navigation.
Recharts powers executive trend, module health and KPI portfolio visualizations with client-mounted chart frames.
AI Analytics Copilot handles company health, next-quarter forecasts, business risks, growth opportunities, KPI performance and strategic actions.
Workspace compatibility route /workspace/analytics points to the new Analytics experience while canonical routes live under /analytics.
databaseAdditions: No new Prisma models were required for this frontend-focused Phase 59.
apiGroupsAdded: No backend API groups were added; frontend service contracts target existing and planned analytics, KPI, forecasting and reporting endpoints.

validationResults.evidence: Installed recharts in the web workspace and verified chart primitives in Phase 59 tests.
Dependencies are up to date in the Desktop NEXORA_AI workspace.
TypeScript compiled cleanly for the Analytics workspace.
6 assertions passed for files, navigation, Copilot intents, module rendering, Recharts usage and routes.
Next.js production build completed cleanly with 66 static routes and stable mounted chart frames.
All 13 Analytics routes returned HTTP 200 with Analytics, Executive, KPI or Strategic content markers.
In-app browser startup failed with the recurring Windows sandbox browser-start failure; HTTP route smoke and production build passed.
12 known vulnerabilities remain tracked from prior phases: 3 moderate, 9 high, 0 critical; automated fixes require semver-major or downgrade decisions.

nextPhase: Phase 60 - Launch Readiness, UX Polish, Quality Assurance, Mobile Optimization and Production UI Release Candidate
